recent_articles.title: Rahul meets Abhishek Banerjee amid push for INDIA bloc coordination - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** met with **Abhishek Banerjee**, national general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, in New Delhi on Wednesday, June 10, 2026. The meeting followed talks between **Mamata Banerjee** and **Sonia Gandhi** earlier that week. These meetings are part of efforts to strengthen unity within the **INDIA** alliance, which aims to present a united front against the BJP. Congress leadership is also holding internal meetings to discuss current political developments.

recent_articles.title: Sukhendu Sekhar Ray distances himself from TMC rebel group - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhendu Sekhar Ray**, former TMC Chief Whip in the Rajya Sabha, resigned from his Upper House seat on Monday and praised colleagues who rebelled against **Mamata Banerjee** and her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**.  He clarified that he was unaware of a meeting with other rebels at actor-turned-politician **Shatabdi Roy's** residence before joining them for 30-40 minutes. Ray also stated his support for the rebellion but did not attend the meeting. He expressed hope for the new BJP government in West Bengal and acknowledged past harassment he faced within the TMC, prompting him to consider leaving politics altogether.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Mamata Banerjee: 'Offer Has To Come From Trinamool': Congress Sources Amid Merger Buzz
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, national general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, met with **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of Opposition, for one and a half hours on Wednesday to strengthen coordination within the opposition INDIA bloc. The meeting followed Mamata Banerjee's meeting with **Sonia Gandhi**, where they discussed the need for greater unity against the BJP.  **The Trinamool Congress** conveyed its desire for a strong alliance and accepted **Rahul Gandhi**'s leadership, while **Congress** has made it clear that any merger proposal must come from them. This comes amidst internal rebellion within the **Trinamool Congress**, with some MLAs and MPs considering an alliance with the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Amid CID searches and TMC rebellion, Mamata meets Sonia in Delhi | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee** met with **Sonia Gandhi** in Delhi to discuss coordination among the INDIA bloc parties.  The **West Bengal CID** conducted searches at the **Trinamool Congress’s** central party office and the office of its national general secretary, **Abhishek Banerjee**, as part of an investigation into alleged Assembly signature forgery. The **TMC** leader, **Kalyan Banerjee**, stated that the party is not worried about rebel MPs joining the NDA and maintains that their strength lies in "Maa, Maati and Maanush".

recent_articles.title: Will Hobnobbing With Trinamool Rebels Cost BJP? What State Leaders Say
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, the **West Bengal** Chief Minister, met with rebel Trinamool Congress MPs at **Satabdi Roy's** Delhi residence. This meeting followed a similar gathering of the rebels at **Bhupendra Yadav's** home earlier in the day. Despite these meetings, the **BJP** maintains it will not induct any Trinamool leaders into its ranks. The BJP leadership argues that this gesture is a political move to weaken the Trinamool party and prepare for upcoming elections.  The BJP has stated that they are focused on cleaning Bengal of the Trinamool party.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal CID reaches Mamata Banerjee’s residence in signature forgery case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Criminal Investigation Department (CID)** of **West Bengal Police** searched the residence of former Chief Minister **Mamata Banerjee** at 30B, Harish Chatterjee Street in connection with allegations of forged signatures from party MLAs.  **Subhasish Chakraborty**, a former Trinamool Congress MP, prevented the search and requested a return visit when either **Mamata Banerjee** or **Abhishek Banerjee** would be present. The CID has registered an FIR based on complaints by MLAs Ritabarta Banerjee and Sandipan Saha alleging forged signatures that led to their expulsion from the party.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool, Abhishek Banerjee offices searched in signature forgery case | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The West Bengal CID** conducted searches at the **Trinamool Congress**'s central office in Kolkata and **Abhishek Banerjee's** office on Camac Street as part of its investigation into alleged Assembly signature forgery.  The searches followed a complaint filed by rebel TMC MLAs Ritabrata Banerjee and Sandipan Saha alleging fabricated signatures on a letter sent to the Assembly Speaker regarding the appointment of the Leader of Opposition. The CID has recorded statements from 13 TMC MLAs, with three disowning the signatures attributed to them. **Abhishek Banerjee** skipped a third summons issued by the Crime Investigation Department citing pending proceedings before the Calcutta High Court and his absence from the city.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Crisis: "BJP Won't Take Them, Not Enough Numbers": Team Mamata Banerjee On Rebels
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Mamata Banerjee** camp condemned rebels who sought support from the BJP-led NDA, calling their actions a betrayal.  Senior MP Kalyan Banerjee stated that the rebels lack sufficient numbers to merge with another party and that they will not be accepted by the BJP. The rebels chose their own chief whip, Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar, defying **Mamata Banerjee's** decision for the post. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Lok Sabha MP, is attempting to convince them to return but they remain adamant.  The rebellion poses a threat to the party leadership and its image among voters.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool rebellion reaches Delhi: 20 party MPs in talks with Union Minister Bhupendra Yadav - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Several Trinamool Congress MPs, including Howrah MP Prasun Banerjee and Bankura MP Anup Chakraborty, held a meeting at **Bhupendra Yadav’s** residence on June 8th, 2026. The meeting, which included 20 Lok Sabha MPs, aims to form a separate bloc and support the BJP-led NDA government.  The rebellion comes after nearly 60 Trinamool MLAs elected Ritabrata Banerjee as Leader of Opposition, signaling a growing rift within the party. **Suvendu Adhikari**, who was likely present at the meeting, is emerging as a potential leader of this new bloc.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Meet Live Updates: Pointed Fingers Or Alliance Unity? All Eyes On Delhi Meeting
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **23** opposition parties are expected to meet in Delhi on Monday to discuss their strategy for the upcoming state and national elections. The meeting, called "Janbandhan," will focus on uniting against the **BJP** and addressing differences between alliance partners.  The **Congress**, **AAP**, **DMK**, and **TVK** are among the parties expected to attend.  **Mamata Banerjee** of the **TMC** is likely to raise concerns about attacks on her party's leaders in Bengal, while **John Brittas** of the **CPI(M)** will address alleged political understanding between the Left and the **BJP** during the Kerala polls.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Rajya Sabha MP Sukhendu Sekhar Roy resigns, says ‘I was unhappy in party’ | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhendu Sekhar Roy**, a veteran Trinamool Congress leader, resigned from the party and his Rajya Sabha seat citing long-standing internal issues.  He stated he will make a decision about joining another party after introspection. **Mamata Banerjee** and her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, are in Delhi for an INDIA opposition bloc meeting following the Trinamool's significant defeat in the West Bengal Assembly election.

recent_articles.title: Falta's 'Pushpa' Jahangir Khan Arrested By Bengal Special Task Force
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jahangir Khan**, a Trinamool strongman, was arrested at the India-Nepal border after being on the radar of law enforcement for alleged threats and election fraud attempts.  Khan had been previously granted interim protection by the Calcutta High Court but it was revoked following the filing of five police cases against him. He had withdrawn from the Falta constituency re-election after allegations of voting machine tampering, branding himself as "Pushpa" in reference to a Telugu action thriller character. **Abhishek Banerjee**, an MP and close aide of **Mamata Banerjee**, has been linked to Khan's activities.  Khan’s arrest follows his withdrawal from the election contest shortly before the re-election.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee Sent Sourav Ganguly To Ask Yusuf Pathan To Quit As MP? What They Said
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sourav Ganguly** and **Yusuf Pathan** have both denied allegations that they were asked to vacate their seats for **Mamata Banerjee**.  A Bengal daily reported that the Trinamool Congress was seeking Ganguly's help to convince Pathan to step down from his Baharampur seat, but Pathan refuted these claims. The reports surfaced amidst a political crisis within the party and as **Banerjee** prepares for a comeback in Bengal politics.

recent_articles.title: 'Undermined Under Abhishek Banerjee': Trinamool Minority Cell Leader Quits
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Ajmal Siddique**, former State Secretary (Minority Cell) of the **Trinamool Congress**, resigned from all party posts and primary membership on Saturday. He cited personal reasons, dissatisfaction with the party's atmosphere and functioning, and concerns about the democratic spirit and treatment of hardworking workers as factors in his decision.  Siddique also expressed displeasure with the leadership style of **Abhishek Banerjee**, the party's General Secretary.

recent_articles.title: Only 8 MLAs, 6 MPs At Mamata Banerjee's Home For Key Meet. Party Clarifies
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Only eight **Trinamool Congress** MLAs attended a National Working Committee meeting at former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee's Kalighat house in Kolkata, following a rebellion within the party.  The party clarified that not all MPs and MLAs were invited, with only four Lok Sabha MPs and two Rajya Sabha MPs present. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata Banerjee's nephew, was among those who attended. Rebel MLA **Ritabrata Banerjee** stated that more MLAs will join the rebellion, increasing the number of supporters beyond 2/3rd of the party.

recent_articles.title: Bandar movie review: Bobby Deol anchors Anurag Kashyap’s strongest film in years | Movie-review News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anurag Kashyap**'s film "Bandar" explores the complexities of a man accused of rape and the woman who claims to be his victim.  The film delves into themes of gender dynamics, privilege, and the Me-Too movement, prompting viewers to question their own moral boundaries. **Bobby Deol**, in a career-defining performance, portrays a washed-out entertainer facing accusations of sexual assault. The supporting cast includes **Sanya Malhotra**, **Riddhi Sen**, and **Sapna Pabbi**.  The film's unique style and thought-provoking narrative make it a compelling watch.

recent_articles.title: A Lok Sabha Problem Awaits Mamata Banerjee? Humanyun Kabir's Big Claim
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Humayun Kabir**, expelled leader of the Trinamool Congress, claims that 20 MPs within the party are planning to remove **Abhishek Banerjee** as the leader of the party in the Lok Sabha.  Kabir, who heads his own party Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP), stated that these MPs have spoken to the Speaker about this potential removal and that a split within the Trinamool is likely. The current internal conflict within the party stems from disagreements over leadership positions, with some MLAs supporting **Ritabrata Banerjee** instead of **Mamata Banerjee's** chosen candidate for the state assembly leader of opposition position.

recent_articles.title: Plague On Both Your Houses: Bengal Minister On Divided Trinamool
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swapan Dasgupta**, a senior Bengal BJP leader, advised against supporting **Trinamool Congress** rebels, stating that the people's mandate for a "complete detoxification process" should be allowed to unfold. He believes the BJP should not intervene in the internal divisions within the party and instead focus on fulfilling its mandate of providing good governance to West Bengal. Dasgupta criticized both factions of the **Trinamool Congress**, suggesting that neither is deserving of support, as they are plagued by corruption and lack of integrity.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Rebels Play In Midfield As They Seek Mamata Banerjee's Advice
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ritabrata Bandopadhyay**, a key figure in the dissident camp within the **Trinamool Congress**, stated that they want **Mamata Banerjee** to remain as an advisor to their opposition group. The dissidents are not directly opposing **Banerjee**, but instead criticize the increasing influence of **Abhishek Banerjee**, IPAC-style political management, and the corporatisation of the party. They aim to project themselves as a separate faction within the Trinamool while maintaining respect for **Banerjee**'s leadership. The dissidents argue that they are seeking advice from **Banerjee** and want to eliminate **Abhishek Banerjee** from the opposition leadership.  The group believes this is an internal struggle for the "opposition space" in Bengal politics, which they believe has been neglected by the Trinamool party.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Trinamool Chaos: Has Mamata Banerjee Reached Her Political Endgame?
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) is facing a severe internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal Assembly elections.  **Mamata Banerjee**, despite retaining her personal appeal, faces a fractured party with 58 MLAs supporting expelled leader **Ritabrata Banerjee** as Leader of the Opposition. The party's organizational structure has been significantly weakened by allegations of centralized control and corporate-style management. **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata's nephew and national general secretary, is facing criticism for his leadership style, further exacerbating the internal conflict.  The TMC's future hinges on whether **Mamata Banerjee** can address these issues and rebuild the party from the grassroots level or if it will fragment into irrelevance.

recent_articles.title: Ritabrata Banerjee, Mamata Banerjee Anatomy Of A Loss: Inside The Collapse And Rise Of "Real Trinamool"
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the Bengal election loss, **Mamata Banerjee**, a three-time chief minister, faces growing dissent within her party.  **Ritabrata Banerjee**, a Trinamool MLA, and other dissidents have publicly challenged **Abhishek Banerjee**, Mamata's nephew, accusing him of centralizing power. The rebellion escalated when the dissidents were expelled from the party and formed their own leadership team. They now claim to represent the "real Trinamool Congress" in the Assembly, while seeking guidance from **Mamata Banerjee**.  The situation has led to a power struggle within the party as it attempts to regain control.

recent_articles.title: Calcutta High Court to hear Abhishek’s plea seeking protection - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, general secretary of the **Trinamool Congress**, was granted permission by the Calcutta High Court to file a petition seeking protection against coercive action from the West Bengal CID. The court is expected to hear the matter later this week.  The legal team representing Mr. Banerjee argued that he had no connection to the case, while Enforcement Directorate officials served him with a notice for questioning in the primary teacher recruitment scam. Two Trinamool MLAs filed a complaint alleging forged signatures on a letter declaring **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay** as the party's choice for Leader of Opposition (LoP), leading to an FIR and summons against Mr. Banerjee. The controversy has caused a split within the party, with at least 58 MLAs forming a new opposition group.

recent_articles.title: Trouble mounts for TMC MP: CID notice pending, ED summons Abhishek Banerjee in teacher recruitment scam | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew of former Chief Minister **Mamata Banerjee**, was summoned by the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** to appear before it on June 15 in connection with the teacher recruitment irregularities case. The ED found evidence linking money from the scam to his company, Leaps and Bounds Pvt Ltd.  The **CID** had also issued a notice to **Abhishek Banerjee** for questioning on June 1 regarding a signature forgery case filed by two TMC MLAs who alleged fabricated resolutions.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee, Abhishek Banerjee, Leader of Opposition, Ritabrata Banerjee, Sandipan Saha - "Real" Trinamool Backs Rebel For Key Post, Says 'Mamata Banerjee Our Leader'
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** MLA Ritabrata Banerjee claims to have the support of 59 MLAs, aiming to challenge **Mamata Banerjee's** nominee for Leader of Opposition, **Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay**.  Banerjee alleges forged signatures on a letter supporting Chattopadhyay. The Assembly Secretariat has filed a police case into the matter, with the CID investigating. Chief Minister **Suvendu Adhikari** stated that three Trinamool MLAs confessed to not signing the document.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool Congress Crisis Live Updates: Back-To-Back Setbacks To Mamata Banerjee-led Party
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress is facing a deepening crisis following its defeat in the West Bengal state election. **Mamata Banerjee**'s nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, was accused of wrongfully electing Sobhandeb Chattopadhyay as the Leader of the Opposition.  **Firhad Hakim**, a close ally of **Mamata Banerjee**, resigned as Kolkata Mayor after seeking permission from her. **Ritabrata Banerjee**, a rebel leader, was appointed Leader of the Opposition by **Rathindra Bose**, the West Bengal Assembly Speaker. The crisis has escalated with rifts within the party and 60 out of 80 MLAs skipping a meeting at **Mamata Banerjee**'s house.  The situation is considered critical for the party as it faces its worst crisis since its inception.

recent_articles.title: 'Maharashtra Model' In West Bengal? Buzz Over New Trinamool Congress Without Mamata Banerjee
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** (TMC) is facing internal dissent following the expulsion of two whistleblower MLAs, Ritabrata Bandopadhyay and Sandipan Saha.  About 60 out of 80 **Trinamool** MLAs missed a meeting at **Mamata Banerjee's** house, raising concerns over party loyalty and unity. **Mamata Banerjee** accused the BJP of attempting to poach her MLAs with intimidation and financial inducements. Some MLAs have met separately, fueling speculation about potential party splits.

recent_articles.title: TMC MLAs, Abhishek Banerjee attack: Only 20 attend Mamata Banerjee Kalighat meeting - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TMC** General Secretary **Abhishek Banerjee** was attacked on Saturday, leading to a low turnout at a legislative party meeting called by **Mamata Banerjee**. Only 20 of the 80 newly elected MLAs attended the meeting at her residence. The absence of nearly three-fourths of the legislators raised concerns, but **TMC** spokesperson **Kunal Ghosh** stated that many were protesting against alleged political violence and police action against party workers.  The party announced plans for protests in rural areas and urban wards on Monday, followed by a sit-in led by **Mamata Banerjee** at Rani Rashmoni Road on Tuesday.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool calls off meeting as three-fourths of its MLAs fail to turn up - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A scheduled meeting of newly elected **Trinamool Congress** legislators was called off after nearly three-fourths of the party's MLAs failed to attend.  The meeting, convened by **Sobhandeb Chatterjee**, and likely to be addressed by former Chief Minister **Mamata Banerjee**, saw only 20 out of 80 attendees present at **Banerjee's** residence. **Kunal Ghosh**, a Trinamool spokesperson, attributed the low turnout to the attack on party general secretary **Abhishek Banerjee** in Sonarpur and ongoing attacks on party leaders and activists.

recent_articles.title: I never saw my representation on screen: Tribeny Rai on why she made 'Shape of Momo' - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An alleged attack on **TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee** during his visit to Sonarpur, West Bengal sparked a major political showdown. Protesters hurled stones and eggs at his convoy, raising "chor chor" slogans, while the incident has drawn criticism from various political parties.

recent_articles.title: 'Bakrid Invite' murder accused killed in encounter I Ghaziabad case - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tribeny Rai**, director of the film "Shape of Momo," discussed her experience growing up without seeing people from the Northeast represented in mainstream cinema. The alleged attack on **TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee** during his visit to Sonarpur, West Bengal, sparked a political showdown after protesters surrounded his convoy and hurled stones and eggs.  The investigation into the death of 17-year-old Surya Pratap Chauhan is ongoing.

recent_articles.title: Rajat Patidar: From being unsold to back-to-back IPL titles with RCB - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajat Patidar**, the man accused of being involved in the "Bakrid Invite" murder, was killed during an encounter with police in Ghaziabad.  The case has taken a dramatic turn after **Patidar's** alleged involvement in the murder and subsequent arrest.

recent_articles.title: Five arrested for attack on TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee; another MP Kalyan Banerjee mobbed at Hooghly - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **West Bengal police** arrested five individuals in connection with the attack on Trinamool Congress leader and MP Abhishek Banerjee.  **Trinamool Congress** leader Kalyan Banerjee was also attacked by a mob while he was on his way to submit a deputation. **Mamata Banerjee**, the Trinamool Congress chairperson, alleged that hospitals were pressured not to admit her nephew, who suffered injuries during the attack. The incident has sparked accusations of political violence from both sides. BJP leaders condemned the attacks but also claimed they reflected public anger towards the **Trinamool Congress**.

recent_articles.title: Attack On Abhishek Banerjee In Bengal Gives INDIA Bloc Fresh Momentum
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, a **Trinamool Congress** MP, was assaulted while visiting the family of a deceased party leader in Bengal. Opposition leaders condemned the attack as an example of the BJP's "politics of vendetta" and expressed concern about its implications for democracy.  The incident has sparked sympathy for **Mamata Banerjee** within the **INDIA alliance**, prompting some leaders to rally in her support. While the future of the **INDIA alliance** remains uncertain, the attack on **Banerjee** may have served as a catalyst for renewed cohesion among opposition parties.

recent_articles.title: Alleged Attacks On Trinamool MPs: Mamata Banerjee To Hit Streets On June 2 | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former West Bengal Chief Minister and leader of the **Trinamool Congress (TMC)**, will lead protests against alleged assaults on her party MPs.  **Abhishek Banerjee**, nephew and TMC national general secretary, was attacked with eggs and bricks while visiting families affected by post-poll violence in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas district. **Kalyan Banerjee**, Lok Sabha MP from Sreerampur, also reported being assaulted near Chanditala police station while on his way to submit a deputation regarding the violence. The BJP has arrested six individuals involved in the assault on **Abhishek Banerjee** and claims the incident was orchestrated by internal factionalism within the TMC.

recent_articles.title: Mamata Banerjee to hit the streets on June 2 after attack on Abhishek, TMC leader - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, **TMC** leader, announced a sit-in protest in Kolkata on June 2nd against alleged attacks on party leaders and workers. The protests follow incidents involving **Abhishek Banerjee** and **Kalyan Banerjee**.  The **TMC** plans statewide demonstrations on June 1st at ward, anchal, and block levels.  Following the alleged attacks on **Abhishek Banerjee**, who was assaulted in Sonarpur, West Bengal Police arrested five individuals for heckling him. The **TMC** has condemned these incidents as attempts to suppress dissenting voices and promote violence.

recent_articles.title: Black flags waived, called ‘thief’: TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee claims BJP supporters attacked him outside police station | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalyan Banerjee**, a **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** MP, alleged he was attacked by a crowd outside a police station in West Bengal's Hooghly district while protesting the arrest of party workers. The incident occurred after protesters greeted him with black flags and chanted "thief" slogans.  He claimed the attack was orchestrated by **BJP** supporters. **Abhishek Banerjee**, another TMC leader, also reported being manhandled during a visit to Sonarpur. He accused the BJP of political violence and state-sponsored terrorism. **Rahul Gandhi**, Congress leader, condemned the attacks on both leaders, calling them "utterly reprehensible."

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee Sonarpur attack: Who attacked Abhishek Banerjee? TMC, BJP pin blame on each other - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following an attack on **Abhishek Banerjee**, the MP for Diamond Harbour, during a visit to Sonarpur in South 24 Parganas district, **TMC** and **BJP** have blamed each other. The **TMC** alleges that the attack was orchestrated by **BJP** supporters, citing the presence of a local **BJP** functionary at the scene. The **BJP**, meanwhile, claims internal factionalism within the **TMC** may be responsible for the incident.  At least five people have been arrested in connection with the attack and are being held pending court appearance.

recent_articles.title: 5 Arrested For Attack On Trinamool Congress TMC Leader Abhishek Banerjee In West Bengal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, **Trinamool Congress** leader, was attacked with stones and eggs while visiting post-poll violence victims in Sonarpur, West Bengal.  Five people have been arrested based on video footage of the incident, which occurred during his visit to the area. The police registered a case suo motu as no formal complaint was filed by Banerjee or the **Trinamool Congress**.  **Mamata Banerjee**, leader of the **Trinamool Congress**, accused the BJP of orchestrating the attack and demanded justice.

recent_articles.title: "You Did Wrong": Mamata Banerjee Heard Scolding Hospital CEO, BJP Shares Video
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former chief minister of West Bengal, was heard scolding the CEO of Belle Vue Hospital in Kolkata after her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, a Lok Sabha MP and her nephew, was attacked by a crowd.  A state BJP leader shared a clip of the incident alleging that **Banerjee** attempted to pressure the hospital to admit her nephew despite his reports showing no significant injuries.
